items.title: Europe’s largest airline warns of jet-fuel prices at $140 this winter as it cuts capacity
items.content: Ryanair on Wednesday reduced its winter capacity to mitigate its exposure to unhedged jet fuel prices of $140 per barrel, illustrating the real-economy impact of the energy crisis.

items.title: We’re in our 60s. My wife and I have $345,000 in annual pensions and $1 million in 403(b)s. Is it too late for Roth conversions?
items.content: “Roth assets would provide our children with tax-free distributions.”

items.title: Dell shares rise as demand jumps for AI servers — here’s what Wall Street analysts are saying happens next
items.content: Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs and Citigroup all raised their price targets for the technology company.

items.title: ‘Mean Girls’ star Amanda Seyfried lists longtime L.A. home for $3.2 million after relocating to rural N.Y.
items.content: Seyfried, who now resides primarily on a beautiful farm property in upstate New York, has used the three-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom home as her West Coast base for more than a decade.

items.title: Sarah Michelle Gellar and Freddie Prinze Jr. cut the price of their $10 million L.A. mansion
items.content: Sarah Michelle Gellar and Freddie Prinze Jr. have trimmed the asking price of their stunning California mansion by $700,000—just three months after listing the dwelling.

items.title: AI capital expenditure forecast to exceed the cost of building railways in both the U.S. and the U.K. — with the internet added on top
items.content: The accounting giant says the buildout of artificial intelligence differs from the development of railways and the internet because of its scale and spending growth.

items.title: Dell’s AI servers drive a stellar earnings performance, and a raised outlook
items.content: The company’s backlog has reached $95 billion as demand accelerates for its AI servers

items.title: Palo Alto Networks’ stock falls despite strong AI cybersecurity demand
items.content: Enterprise cyber threats and AI adoption are giving Palo Alto Networks ‘durable tailwinds,’ according to CEO Nikesh Arora, but the stock retreated after an earnings beat

items.title: ‘I’m leaving money on the table’: I’m 64 and my husband is 70. Should I take spousal benefits or wait for my own?
items.content: “I paid a significant amount into Social Security.”

items.title: ‘It’s not fair’: My twin brother and I were left houses by our parents. Can I make him pay his share for taxes and upkeep?
items.content: “I am frustrated and financially exhausted from continuing to invest my own money into these properties.”
